content:
{'translation': 'Stephen Colbert 於週二重返深夜電視節目，但這次是以嘉賓身份亮相 Jimmy Kimmel 的節目。', 'source': "Stephen Colbert returned to late-night television on Tuesday, appearing as a guest on Jimmy Kimmel's show."}

{'translation': '看來他對舊工作有某部分一點都不懷念。', 'source': 'Apparently, some parts of the old job he does not miss at all.'}

{'translation': '他說：「我終於有機會不用每天想著新聞，所以我接受了。」', 'source': '"I finally have a chance to not think about the news every day, so I said yes," he said.'}

{'translation': 'Kimmel 提到 Colbert 看起來更加開心和健康。', 'source': 'Kimmel noted that Colbert looked happier and healthier.'}

{'translation': 'Colbert 回應：「是不是好像我不用每天喝一杯毒藥那樣？」', 'source': '"Does it look like I don\'t have to drink a cup of poison every day?" Colbert responded.'}

{'translation': 'Kimmel 向 Colbert 祝賀他的《The Late Show》在週一橫掃艾美獎，包括獲得最佳綜藝節目獎。', 'source': 'Kimmel congratulated Colbert on his show sweeping the Emmy Awards on Monday, including winning Outstanding Talk Series.'}

{'translation': 'Kimmel 問：「CBS 那邊有沒有人打電話恭喜你拿到七個艾美獎？」', 'source': '"Did anyone from CBS call to congratulate you on the seven Emmys?" Kimmel asked.'}

{'translation': 'Colbert 開玩笑說：「我不認識那間機構。」', 'source': '"I don\'t know that organization," Colbert joked.'}

{'translation': '不過在今年較早時取消他的節目之後，電視台確實給了他一樣東西：他們將他在節目期間穿過的 40 套西裝寄給了他。', 'source': 'But after canceling his show earlier this year, the network did give him one thing: They sent him the 40 suits he wore on the show.'}

{'translation': '他說：「那些西裝就這樣擺在客房，我不知道怎麼處理。如果有人剛讀完法律學院需要一套西裝，請打電話給 Jimmy，他會幫你傳話給我。」', 'source': '"They sit in the guest room, and I don\'t know what to do with them," he said. "If anybody just graduated from law school and needs a suit, please call Jimmy and he\'ll relay the message to me."'}
